why: The authors provide a complete R package plus dedicated toy-example scripts. The target C1 uses the n=8 toy dataset hardcoded in Section 4/scripts, so no external data or weights are missing. The code is directly runnable after installing R and small CRAN dependencies.
blockers_seen: R runtime is not listed in the machine metadata and may need installation.
Small CRAN/package dependencies may need installation before running the scripts.

feasibility.est_runtime_on_this_machine: Under 1 minute for the toy computation once R and dependencies are installed; roughly 10-15 minutes including a fresh R/dependency setup.

compute.basis: A single n=8 toy computation: MCD covariance, chi-square p-values, Holm/BH/PFER adjustments, and lambda=max(lambda_stat,lambda_data); no training or large data.
